A Russian FPV drone operator struck a light anti-drone air defense system, identified as MAAWLR, operated by the Armed Forces of Ukraine and produced by the American company Sierra Nevada Corp.
The MAAWLR system is mounted on a pickup truck chassis and is equipped with an electro-optical targeting system for autonomous target detection, while also being capable of receiving external target designation from radar assets. It can use a range of missiles, including AIM-9M, AIM-132 ASRAAM, AIM-120 AMRAAM, IRIS-T, R-27, and APKWS II.
Depending on the munition used, the system is assessed to be capable of engaging drones at ranges of approximately 6–15 km.
